DESCRIPTION: The grazing treatment specifies what percentage of forage remains at the end of the grazing season, which is usually in October: 65% for light, 50% for moderate, 35% for heavy and 20 for extreme.  These grazing treatments are accomplished by placing less to more animals out on pasture.
Acres required to provide forage, assuming an average year’s forage production on a loamy ecological site (2,848 lbs/acre in an average year)
Stocking rate in AUM/acre is the inverse of the number of acres provided.
